title: Assess fairness of acceptance policy reads across projects
outcome: Claude7077 final Low: router-wide two-read pool lets slow reads for one project return 429 for another. Separate write slot already prevents read starvation of writes. Evaluate per-project fairness while retaining a bounded global process budget; do not blindly allocate unbounded per-project CLI concurrency. Record decision or implement bounded fairness with two-project deterministic regression. Documented current 429 behavior is not a Medium blocker.
